content.text: Crash cart sealed/stocked & inspected w/in required interval
Pads/paddles available & connected; both anterior-P. & anterior-lateral available
Airway equipment: BVM, OPA sizes, NPA sizes, laryngoscope + blades (Mac 3/4; Miller 2/3), ETT sizes (6.0-8.0), 10cc syringe, tube holder, stylet, lubricant
Waveform capnography (ETCO2) attached & functional - verify waveform display
IV supplies: 18g & 20g needles, IV tubing, normal saline flush syringes, tourniquet, tape
IO device (EZ-IO or FAST1) available & charged

Code meds available & w/in date: epinephrine (10 mg/10 mL x3), amiodarone (300 mg + 150 mg), atropine, adenosine (6 mg x2; 12 mg x2), Na bicarb (50 mEq), magnesium 2 g, calcium chloride 1 g, lidocaine
Suction device (Yankauer) functional; turned on & ready
CPR feedback device charged & available (if institution uses)
